title: attempt-record
description: The record of one phase attempt, written by the engine. Feature 101 (T002); the field list is the table "Record of a phase attempt" of specs/101-gate-and-verdict/data-model.md, and the specification stands where the two differ.
x-annex: feature 101, data-model.md, "Record of a phase attempt"

phase.description: The phase the attempt belongs to

ordinal.description: The ordinal of the phase attempt inside its phase

engineStartOrdinal.description: The ordinal of the engine start the phase attempt ran under

kind.description: The kind that the attempt planner gave (feature 100 annex E §E.1; annex X §X.6 row 9)

role.description: `proposer` or `accelerator`, read from the role registry; the registry is open, so this schema closes no list of roles (F100-FR-023)

harness.description: The harness that ran the passes of the phase attempt

model.description: The model that ran the passes of the phase attempt

modelTier.description: The model tier that ran the passes of the phase attempt

planned.description: The decision record of the attempt planner, as it returned it; absent where no planner ran

signature.description: The signature of unmet criteria of the feedback that led to this phase attempt; absent for the first phase attempt of a phase

outcome.description: How the phase attempt ended. A field of this record only: the verdict stays one of the three members of the closed set of verdicts (annex X §X.6 row 8), and `gate-failed` and `no-verdict` have no verdict

archived.description: Whether the phase attempt was archived, and the label of the archive
Whether the phase attempt was archived

label.description: The label of the archive, or null where the phase attempt was not archived
